content_sections.heading: CCRUM Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 02/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CCRUM notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Officers of the Central/State Govt. including autonomous bodies/Research Institution/Public Sector Undertaking/Semi Govt. or autonomous organizations funded by the Government; Holding analogous posts on regular basis and fulfilling the educational and other qualifications prescribed for Direct Recruitment; OR; 03 years' regular service in Pay Band of Rs. 9300-34800+GP Rs.4600 or 08 years' regular service in Pay Band of Rs. 9300-34800+GP Rs. 4200, possessing educational qualification and experience prescribed for direct recruits; A degree from a recognized University Experience: At least 7 years' experience in a Govt./Semi Govt./Public Undertaking out of which 3 years should be in a supervisory capacity Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on last date for receipt of applications) Other conditions: Open only to officers of Central/State Govt., autonomous bodies, research institutions, PSUs or Govt.-funded semi-Govt./autonomous organisations Deputation includes Short term Contract Desirable: Adequate experience in personnel management with thorough knowledge of accounts, budget, budgetary control, Government rules and regulations and administrative and establishment procedure Knowledge of Computer

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial deputation period of 03 years, which may be extended based on performance up to 05 years Pay, allowances and other terms regulated by Department of Personnel & Training instructions issued from time to time

rows.event: Advertisement published in Employment News (issue dated 14-20 November 2026)

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Vigilance clearance, including whether any disciplinary case is pending or being contemplated against the officer Major/Minor Penalty statement for the last 5 years Integrity Certificate Photocopies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years, duly attested on each page

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CCRUM Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Prepare the application in the prescribed format (proforma downloadable from https://ccrum.ayush.gov.in). Send the application through the Cadre Controlling Authority. Address it to the Director General, Central Council For Research In Unani Medicine, 61-65, Institutional Area, Opp. D Block, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058. Application must be sent within 30 days from the date of publication of the vacancy in Employment News. Cadre Controlling Authority encloses vigilance clearance, penalty statement, Integrity Certificate and attested ACR/APAR copies. Make sure it reaches by 18 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Cadre Controlling Authority may ensure that the applicant fulfils all the eligibility Vacancy circular is also circulated among officers and staff of CCRAS, CCRH and CCRYN
